answer: A mesa observatory renting agents for nebula analysis caps total voting credit at a budget issued by audited scientific institutions. Each delegation moves credit instead of copying it: if one institution gives a thread of agents 100 credits, all descendants together can spend at most 100. The ledger debits every transfer and consumes votes once, with no signup bonus. Sybil branches cannot amplify the original allocation. A farm needs more independent institutions to delegate or must corrupt them. This relies on honest institution admission and conserved accounting; insiders can still collude.
